options.description: Search/replace through all the tables registered to $wpdb in a multisite install.

options.name: --all-tables-with-prefix
options.description: Enable replacement on any tables that match the table prefix even if not registered on $wpdb.

options.name: --all-tables
options.description: Enable replacement on ALL tables in the database, regardless of the prefix, and even if not registered on $wpdb. Overrides --network and --all-tables-with-prefix.

options.name: --export
options.description: Write transformed data as SQL file instead of saving replacements to the database. If <file> is not supplied, will output to STDOUT.

options.name: --export_insert_size
options.description: Define number of rows in single INSERT statement when doing SQL export. You might want to change this depending on your database configuration (e.g. if you need to do fewer queries). Default: 50

options.name: --skip-tables
options.description: Do not perform the replacement on specific tables. Use commas to specify multiple tables. Wildcards are supported, e.g. `'wp_*options'` or `'wp_post*'`.

options.name: --skip-columns
options.description: Do not perform the replacement on specific columns. Use commas to specify multiple columns.

options.name: --include-columns
options.description: Perform the replacement on specific columns. Use commas to specify multiple columns.

options.name: --precise
options.description: Force the use of PHP (instead of SQL) which is more thorough, but slower.

options.name: --recurse-objects
options.description: Enable recursing into objects to replace strings. Defaults to true; pass --no-recurse-objects to disable.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Prints rows to the console as they're updated.

options.name: --regex
options.description: Runs the search using a regular expression (without delimiters). Warning: search-replace will take about 15-20x longer when using --regex.

options.name: --regex-flags
options.description: Pass PCRE modifiers to regex search-replace (e.g. 'i' for case-insensitivity).

options.name: --regex-delimiter
options.description: The delimiter to use for the regex. It must be escaped if it appears in the search string. The default value is the result of `chr(1)`.

options.name: --regex-limit
options.description: The maximum possible replacements for the regex per row (or per unserialized data bit per row). Defaults to -1 (no limit).

options.name: --format
options.description: Render output in a particular format.

options.name: --report
options.description: Produce report. Defaults to true.

options.name: --report-changed-only
options.description: Report changed fields only. Defaults to false, unless logging, when it defaults to true.

options.name: --log
options.description: Log the items changed. If <file> is not supplied or is "-", will output to STDOUT. Warning: causes a significant slow down, similar or worse to enabling --precise or --regex.

options.name: --before_context
options.description: For logging, number of characters to display before the old match and the new replacement. Default 40. Ignored if not logging.

options.name: --after_context
options.description: For logging, number of characters to display after the old match and the new replacement. Default 40. Ignored if not logging.
